::: {#sol-root-trace}

| Test | `r` | $(r + 1)^2$ | $(r + 1)^2 \le 20$? |
|:----:|:---:|:-----------:|:-------------------:|
| 1    | 0   | 1           | true                |
| 2    | 1   | 4           | true                |
| 3    | 2   | 9           | true                |
| 4    | 3   | 16          | true                |
| 5    | 4   | 25          | false               |

The condition is false at the fifth test, so the loop stops there,
and `root(20)` returns 4.
The answer satisfies $4^2 = 16 \le 20 < 25 = 5^2$:
4 is the largest integer whose square is at most 20.

:::
